title: Dominic and the Choir
author: Mara Winterbourne
blurb: Theo Blackwood, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
